visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: The Rest of the List Is Lost
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The list 1, 2, 3, 4 should be printed as [4, 3, 2, 1] after reversing, but the program prints [1].
visualizerParams.buggyCode:
class Node:
    def __init__(self, value, next=None):
        self.value = value
        self.next = next


def reverse(head):
    prev = None
    while head is not None:
        head.next = prev
        nxt = head.next
        prev = head
        head = nxt
    return prev


head = Node(1, Node(2, Node(3, Node(4))))
node = reverse(head)
values = []
while node is not None:
    values.append(node.value)
    node = node.next
print(values)

solution.code:
class Node:
    def __init__(self, value, next=None):
        self.value = value
        self.next = next


def reverse(head):
    prev = None
    while head is not None:
        nxt = head.next
        head.next = prev
        prev = head
        head = nxt
    return prev


head = Node(1, Node(2, Node(3, Node(4))))
node = reverse(head)
values = []
while node is not None:
    values.append(node.value)
    node = node.next
print(values)
solution.explanation: Saving the next node after head.next has been overwritten just saves prev. The pointer to the rest of the list is gone, the loop ends after the first node, and the other nodes are lost. Save first, then relink.
